confidence_notes: The FX figure is the RBA overview page's 18 Nov 2026 4pm USD rate, found through one search. Food and drink anchors come from one search of aggregated sources (Nomadic Matt, Numbeo-derived sites, TripBase). Those sources gave beer at about 14,000 LAK, cappuccino at about 30,000 LAK and a nicer sit-down meal at about 150,000 LAK. Cocktail and wine had no direct price data. I set them as multiples of beer price, reflecting tourist-oriented Vang Vieng bars and imported wine. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, with no listings checked, and are the least certain. Prices vary seasonally.
comparable_city_reasoning: Backpacker-oriented Laos and northern SEA tourist towns such as Luang Prabang, with Vang Vieng priced a little below Luang Prabang.
